message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSVs and applies literal_eval transforms but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, null checks, or value-range guards on the ingested data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Pre-trained models are loaded from HuggingFace Hub (bert-base-uncased) and local paths without any checksum verification, pinned commit/revision, or authentication mechanism.

No detected label flipping detection: The code applies literal_eval to parse label columns but performs no validation of label values against an expected set, no distribution comparison, and no label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code reads CSVs, parses columns, and builds vocabularies/datasets without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious input samples.

No detected model integrity verification: Pretrained models are loaded via `transformers.BertModel.from_pretrained('bert-base-uncased')` and `Word2Vec.load(args.w2vmodel)` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision/commit hash.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distribution before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: Standard Adam optimizer is used with no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or DP-SGD mechanisms applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, Cleverhans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test set is used, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no cross-validation independence enforcement, and notably the GRU branch reuses train_diagnosis for the test dataset (line ~88), indicating the test split is not reliably isolated.
No detected input sanitization: Inputs are read directly from CSV files and passed through tokenization/preprocessing without any shape, range, schema, or null validation before reaching the model.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are collected and passed directly to calculate_metrics without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although BERT processes text, this is a classification model (not a generative LLM), and there are no prompt-injection filters, system-prompt isolation, or output content moderation mechanisms present.
